run_confusion_matrix_from_checkpoint: run the confusion matrix tool with a config file and .pth checkpoint to evaluate model predictions
run_confusion_matrix_from_predictions: run the confusion matrix tool with a config file and dumped .pkl predictions pickle file
run_confusion_matrix_with_visualization: run the confusion matrix tool with --show to display the metric result via matplotlib
run_confusion_matrix_save_image: run the confusion matrix tool with --show-path to save the visualization image to a file
run_confusion_matrix_with_options: run the confusion matrix tool with --cfg-options to override settings in the config file
